description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to QUIC path validation in the quic namespace, including context, validator, and delegate classes, as well as associated enums and data structures.

classes.name: QuicPathValidationContext
classes.description: Interface providing path validation context, including addresses and a writer.

classes.name: QuicPathValidator
classes.description: Handles the process of validating a network path via PATH_CHALLENGE and PATH_RESPONSE frames.

classes.name: QuicPathValidator::SendDelegate
classes.description: Interface for sending PATH_CHALLENGE frames and obtaining retry timeouts.

classes.name: QuicPathValidator::ResultDelegate
classes.description: Interface for handling validation success or failure outcomes.

classes.name: ProbingData
classes.description: Data structure for storing probing frame buffer and send time during validation.

methods.name: QuicPathValidationContext::~QuicPathValidationContext
methods.description: Virtual destructor for the validation context interface.

methods.name: QuicPathValidator::StartPathValidation
methods.description: Initiates path validation by sending a PATH_CHALLENGE.

methods.name: QuicPathValidator::OnPathResponse
methods.description: Handles incoming PATH_RESPONSE frames and matches them to sent challenges.

methods.name: QuicPathValidator::HasPendingPathValidation
methods.description: Checks if a path validation is currently pending.

methods.name: QuicPathValidator::ReleaseContext
methods.description: Releases ownership of the validation context.

methods.name: QuicPathValidator::GetPathValidationReason
methods.description: Returns the reason for path validation.

methods.name: QuicPathValidator::OnRetryTimeout
methods.description: Handles retry timeout for PATH_CHALLENGE frames.

methods.name: QuicPathValidator::IsValidatingPeerAddress
methods.description: Checks if a peer address is currently being validated.

methods.name: QuicPathValidator::MaybeWritePacketToAddress
methods.description: Sends a packet to a specified address if validation is pending.

methods.name: QuicPathValidator::SendPathChallengeAndSetAlarm
methods.description: Sends a PATH_CHALLENGE and sets the retry alarm.
